"""Replay the untouched lifecycle model against current and starting retention_fs."""
import subprocess
import sys
import types
import pytest

@pytest.mark.parametrize('revision',['current','b20cf84ad'])
def test_lifecycle_existing_counterexample(monkeypatch,revision):
    if revision != 'current':
        from subfleet import attempt_tmp
        name='subfleet.retention_fs_lifecycle_base'
        module=types.ModuleType(name)
        sys.modules[name]=module
        source=subprocess.run(['git','show',revision+':subfleet/retention_fs.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
        exec(compile(source,'<retention_fs at '+revision+'>','exec'),module.__dict__)
        monkeypatch.setattr(attempt_tmp,'rfs',module)
    from tests.unit.test_attempt_tmpdir_lifecycle import test_generated_attempt_lifetimes_preserve_isolation_and_cleanup_authority
    test_generated_attempt_lifetimes_preserve_isolation_and_cleanup_authority.hypothesis.inner_test(
        steps=[('start',0,False),('swap',0,False),('vanish',0,False)])
